summary: Barings Private Credit Corporation, a non-traded Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine continuous private placement: 1,104,539.715 unregistered shares sold for approximately $22.0 million under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S, priced per Section 23 of the Investment Company Act. NAV per share was $19.92 as of August 31, 2026; the Board declared a regular $0.167 monthly distribution payable October 28 to holders of record October 26. Cumulative offering stands at 146,308,426.34 shares for $3,014.5 million within a $4.5 billion program. No special-situation event, no deal terms.
